reviewer: Claude Code nightly (Opus), inspected all 34 sheets; fixed scene 5 (salute) and reviewed it again

content.notes: Cover: the shoemaker in his workshop, the captain's uniform on a hanger, headline DER FALSCHE HAUPTMANN matching 'Ein Schuster'.

action.notes: Hammers on the shoe three times; the uniform hangs beside him.

motion.notes: The hammer stays in his hand and follows the arm; the shoe stays on the workbench.

composition.notes: Headline at the top, face and uniform clear, subtitle on the workbench area.

timing.notes: First hammer blow at 0.3 s on 'Schuster'.

content.notes: Voigt in captain's uniform gives soldiers an order (line 0).

action.notes: Straightens up, points, the soldiers turn and stand to attention.

motion.notes: The pointing arm stays attached to the shoulder; soldiers stay in place.

composition.notes: Voigt on the left, the group on the right, street background.

timing.notes: Arm points out at about 2.6 on 'befiehlt Soldaten'.

content.notes: Arrest of the mayor, label BÜRGERMEISTER.

action.notes: Two soldiers step in, grab both arms, papers fly.

motion.notes: The soldiers' hands hold the mayor's shoulders; the papers fly from the desk and fall.

composition.notes: The mayor is centred; the label sits next to the picture.

content.notes: Taking the money from the STADTKASSE.

action.notes: Lid opens, a hand in a uniform sleeve reaches in, grabs the notes and lifts them out.

motion.notes: The notes stay in the hand once gripped; the lid stays open.

composition.notes: Close-up of the cash box with a clear label.

timing.notes: The hand grips the money at about 6.1 on 'Geld'.

action.notes: Glance at each other, then salute together.

motion.notes: Fixed: soldiers spaced further apart; the salute hand now sits in front of each soldier's own helmet brim (previously the elbow ran into the neighbour's head and the hand was hidden). The in-between at 7.9 is a short swing.

composition.notes: Three soldiers, symmetrical, faces above the subtitle.

action.notes: Building, red 1906 stamp slams down, birds fly up.

motion.notes: The stamp shrinks onto the tower; birds fly away from the stamp.

composition.notes: Building fills the frame, stamp easy to read.

content.notes: Köpenick next to Berlin on a paper map.

action.notes: Pin drops, sticks into the small circle, then KÖPENICK and BERLIN labels.

motion.notes: The pin falls in an arc and stops where it sticks.

composition.notes: Simple map, labels easy to read.

timing.notes: Pin sticks around 11.9 on 'Köpenick'; BERLIN appears with 'Berlin'.

action.notes: File slides in, the photo develops, the name is typed letter by letter.

motion.notes: The file slides in and stops; photo and text appear without jumps.

composition.notes: The file fills the frame; the name sits in a large box.

timing.notes: The photo is clear by 13.8 and the name is being typed on 'Wilhelm Voigt'.

action.notes: Bars slam down, he flinches, the tally marks on the wall go up.

motion.notes: The bars drop from the top and stop; his face changes from calm to startled.

composition.notes: Cell, light from the window, face clear.

action.notes: Turns out his empty pockets, shrugs.

motion.notes: The pocket linings come out at his hands; arms open in a shrug.

composition.notes: Figure in the centre of the street, label at the top.

action.notes: HAUPTMANN tag on the uniform, KEIN RANG stamp, the tag gets crossed out.

motion.notes: The stamp drops large and shrinks into place; the line crosses out the word.

composition.notes: Voigt in civilian clothes beside the uniform, clear contrast.

action.notes: Calendar flips 13→14→15→16, stops, small 1906 below.

motion.notes: Each page flips up and away; the number stays on 16.

composition.notes: Large, clear calendar.

timing.notes: Stops on 16 at about 22.2 on 'sechzehnten Oktober'.

action.notes: Buttons the coat, picks up the helmet, lifts it, puts it on and lowers his hand.

motion.notes: The helmet stays at the hand until it sits on the head; the hand then lowers.

composition.notes: Mirror in the background, figure on the left.

timing.notes: Helmet on the head at 24.37 on 'Uniform an'.

content.notes: Stopping a group of soldiers in the street.

action.notes: Voigt steps out and raises his arm; the column stops and bumps together.

motion.notes: The soldiers' legs stop walking, they bunch up, faces startled.

composition.notes: Column on the left, Voigt on the right.

timing.notes: Raised arm and stop at 26.7 on 'Gruppe Soldaten an'.

action.notes: Speaks, points, the soldiers turn.

motion.notes: The pointing arm is steady; the soldiers turn their heads.

composition.notes: Captain on the left, the line of soldiers recedes to the right.

action.notes: The group marches steadily while the background slides.

motion.notes: Legs alternate; Voigt marches beside them.

composition.notes: The group is in the middle of the frame.

content.notes: Arriving at the Köpenick town hall, label RATHAUS KÖPENICK.

action.notes: The group walks in, stops; the door opens and Voigt points.

motion.notes: The group stops in front of the door; the door opens before he points.

composition.notes: Building fills the frame, the group small but clear.

content.notes: Leading out the mayor (and the Stadtkämmerer, line 7).

action.notes: Voigt points, the door opens, soldiers lead the mayor out.

motion.notes: The soldiers' hands hold the mayor's arms; he walks with them.

composition.notes: Voigt on the left, the group on the right, label at the top.

action.notes: He is writing; a hand lands on his shoulder, the pen falls, he raises his hands.

motion.notes: The pen falls from his hand onto the desk; the soldier's hand stays on his shoulder.

composition.notes: Desk in the middle, label on the bookshelf.

timing.notes: Hand on the shoulder at 37.2 on 'verhaften'.

content.notes: Demanding the handover of the city's money.

action.notes: Voigt (from behind) holds out his hand, the cashier pushes the cash box over, the lid opens.

motion.notes: The box moves from the cashier's hands to the counter in front of Voigt and then opens.

composition.notes: Over-the-shoulder view, counter behind bars.

content.notes: The uniform made the con man possible: HOCHSTAPLER.

action.notes: The coat flies in, he puts it on, label, halo.

motion.notes: Changes from grey civilian clothes to the uniform; same face and moustache.

composition.notes: Figure centred, label at the top.

content.notes: Chain of cause and effect: uniform → BEWAFFNET → DIEBSTAHL.

action.notes: Each layer appears in turn with an arrow pointing down.

motion.notes: Arrows draw downward in sequence; the box opens at the end.

composition.notes: Vertical diagram, labels clear. The first 0.2 s is an almost empty frame before the diagram starts (accepted, very short).

content.notes: Voigt is later arrested, label FESTGENOMMEN.

action.notes: Sips coffee, the door bursts open, a policeman grabs him, the cup falls.

motion.notes: The cup slips from his hand onto the desk and spills; the policeman's hand holds his shoulder.

composition.notes: Desk in the middle, door on the left.

action.notes: Bars slam down, he bows his head.

motion.notes: Same cell as scene 9, now in brown civilian clothes; the bars drop and stop.

composition.notes: Repeats scene 9's composition to signal the return to prison.

content.notes: The story spreads in the press.

action.notes: Three newspapers slide in one after another.

motion.notes: Each paper slides in and stops, stacking on the others.

composition.notes: Newspapers fill the frame.

action.notes: A ring spreads from Berlin and newspapers fly out past the border.

motion.notes: The ring and dashed lines spread outward continuously.

composition.notes: Simple map, BERLIN and DEUTSCHLAND labels, no other country names made up.

timing.notes: The newspapers cross the border on 'hinaus' (54.2).

content.notes: Famous: a framed portrait, camera flashes.

action.notes: Flashes go off in turn.

motion.notes: Flashes are short; the portrait stays still.

composition.notes: Portrait centred, cameras on both sides.

action.notes: The gate opens, he steps out, the 1908 stamp lands.

motion.notes: Walks out of the gate with legs alternating; the gate stays open.

composition.notes: Bright gate, figure in brown clothes and bowler hat.

action.notes: The train runs with him at the window; telegraph poles slide past.

motion.notes: The wheels turn and the poles move steadily; the window position stays fixed.

composition.notes: Train fills the middle of the frame.

timing.notes: Train already running on 'reiste er umher' (58.66).

action.notes: A coin drops into the box, he signs, holds up a postcard.

motion.notes: The postcard stays in his raised hand; the visitors react.

composition.notes: Stall in the middle of the street, three people.

action.notes: The lights come on, the curtain opens, the actor in uniform points.

motion.notes: The curtain pulls to both sides; the actor stands under the spotlight.

composition.notes: Red curtain and spotlight easy to read.

action.notes: Projector turns on, the image appears with soldiers walking.

motion.notes: The beam goes from the projector to the screen; the figures on screen move.

composition.notes: Screen in the upper frame, label below it.

action.notes: HAUPTMANN → VON KÖPENICK appear, the uniform lights up.

motion.notes: Text appears in sequence; the poster stays fixed.

composition.notes: Large poster, text clear.

content.notes: The shoemaker who pulled off the trick (the name outlived him).

action.notes: Back in the same workshop as scene 1; he looks up, then fades out, leaving the poster.

motion.notes: The fade is smooth; the shoe and hammer stay on the workbench.

composition.notes: Same layout as the cover, the poster on the wall.

timing.notes: Fade starts after 'Schuster' (71.72) and ends at 75.6.

hook.notes: Frame 0: headline DER FALSCHE HAUPTMANN, shoemaker hammering beside the uniform; the first hammer blow at 0.3 s and the cut at 2.05 s.

continuity.notes: Voigt keeps the same face and moustache across all three outfits (apron, grey patched coat, uniform, brown coat with bowler hat); the town hall and prison cell repeat consistently; the ending returns to the opening workshop.

pacing.notes: 34 shots / 75.7 s ≈ 2.2 s per shot; wide, medium and object close-up views alternate; every shot has its own action (stamp, bars, calendar, cash box, newspapers).
